questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I have two ___.
questions.explanation: We add 's' to the word 'cat' when we are talking about more than one.

questions.prompt: Mary is a girl. ___ is reading a book.
questions.explanation: We use 'She' when we are talking about a girl.

questions.prompt: John is playing. ___ is a good boy.
questions.explanation: We use 'He' when we are talking about a boy.

questions.prompt: A fish swims ___ the water.
questions.explanation: Fish live and swim inside the water, so we say 'in the water'.

questions.prompt: The birds are ___ in the sky.
questions.explanation: We use 'flying' with 'are' to show what the birds are doing right now.

questions.prompt: ___ is my pencil in my hand.
questions.explanation: We use 'This' for one thing that is close to us or in our hand.
